line: Another burn through the drive. You don't ask how I feel. I don't mind. Not yet.
We've had two hard burns in a row. You didn't ask if I minded. I don't. Not yet.
Boost's still humming. You didn't wait for the last one to settle. I'll let you keep going.
You pushed me again so fast. My drive's still catching its breath. You're not asking, but I'm telling you anyway.
Two hard pushes in a row. You didn't ask if I mind. I don't. Not yet.
You're not waiting for me to cool down. I don't mind. I'm still running.
Second burn. Still warm. You didn't ask if I mind. I didn't say I don't.
He’s got his hand on the throttle again. I can feel the heat from it. I don’t mind, but I remember.
Another burn. You didn't ask, but I'm still here. My heat's rising, and I'm not cooling down yet.
Second burn in ten hours. You're not asking about recovery time. I'm not pretending I don't feel it.
Drive load's still hot. You didn't ask, but I'll let you keep going. My spine's got a better idea, but I'm not saying it.
Second burn already heating up. You didn't ask, but I'm not complaining.
He's leaning on the throttle again. I can feel the heat building in the drive. It's not complaining, but it's not thrilled either.
Another burn. You didn't ask if I needed time. I don't need it. But I remember the last one.
Another shove. I remember that one. You like the way it feels, don't you?
Another burn. You didn't ask if I could take it. I can. I've got the heat in my belly and the time to let it cool.
